details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:646-649,861,939-956 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: On a mixed route, an earlier failed fix-up op sets ops_failed, so the guard at line 646 skips the later heal_report op. heal_planned then stays false, the harness report is never sent, and the post-loop warning (gated on heal_planned) never fires.
  WHY: The harness part of the verdict is silently dropped with no page. Reviewers rated this MAJOR; the "high" severity maps from MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:538,570 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The heal report payload is always built with kind issue (`--kind issue`), including for pull-request items.
  WHY: The intake rejects it as kind_mismatch and files nothing, but the judge logs outcome=sent, which is a false success. Reviewers rated this MAJOR (gemini gave no severity); the "high" severity maps from MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:639-646 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: _heal_report_op always builds the report as issue kind, so a harness-routed PR item is rejected by the intake's kind_mismatch binding (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2606-2611).
  WHY: Every harness-routed PR gets a false-success outcome=sent and no heal issue is filed. Rated MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:913-921 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When an earlier op failed and the heal report was skipped for no_accepted_label, the failed-ops branch sends "could not send the harness heal report ... a write failed". This replaces the planner's accurate no-escalation-label WARNING.
  WHY: The operator is pointed at the wrong cause. Rated NIT.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:924-953 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: With WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false and no accepted label, the skip reason is workflow_heal_disabled. The planner's WARNING and the post-loop WARNING both fire for one verdict.
  WHY: The operator is paged twice for one item. Rated NIT.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:527-531 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The accepted-label case list is a hand-copied third copy of the intake label contract with no parity test.
  WHY: If the intake's labels grow, the judge refuses them with label_not_accepted and the harness report is never sent. Rated NIT.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:583-606,591 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: heal_dispatch.json and heal_identity.jwt hold the OIDC token and are created with the default umask.
  WHY: The files are removed on every exit path, so exposure is limited to a few seconds on the runner. Anthropic stated it was not reporting this as a defect. Rated NIT. z-ai said it follows existing convention and did not report it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Done when the judge tests cover the harness verdict, the mixed verdict and a missing field across P3a-P3b."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_unblock_judge.py (a mixed-verdict test run through the judge path, via _judge)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The harness verdict and the missing target_repo are covered through _judge. The mixed case is covered only by test_guard_log_reports_a_mixed_route, the test_mixed_route_* tests with hand-built op lists passed to unblock_run_ops, and the plan-level test. No test drives a mixed verdict through unblock_judge.sh. Severity ranged from NIT to MAJOR (qwen gave MAJOR). z-ai considered this satisfied by an accepted deferral.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:646,861,944 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If an earlier fix-up op fails on a mixed route, ops_failed is true when heal_report is reached. The guard skips it before the heal_report case runs, so heal_planned stays false.
  WHY: The harness report is never sent and no warning says so. The post-loop warning is gated on heal_planned. The fix is to set heal_planned="true" when the guard skips a heal_report op.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:913-921 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When an earlier op failed and the heal report was skipped for no_accepted_label, the failed-ops branch sends a misleading message. Separately, WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false with no accepted label produces two WARNINGs.
  WHY: The operator gets a misleading cause or duplicate pages. Routing is not affected.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:583-606 | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: heal_dispatch.json and heal_identity.jwt hold the OIDC token and are created with the default umask.
  WHY: The files are removed on every exit path. There is no concrete failure path, so it was not reported as a defect.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:527-531 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The accepted-label list is a third hand-copied version of the intake label contract. No test checks the three against each other.
  WHY: If the intake labels grow, the planner marks the op sendable but the judge returns label_not_accepted, so the report is never sent.
- TASK_GAP: tests/test_unblock_judge.py
  Requirement: "Done when the judge tests cover the harness verdict, the mixed verdict and a missing field across P3a-P3b."
  Expected change site: tests/test_unblock_judge.py, a full judge run with a mixed verdict
  Evidence of absence: The harness verdict and the missing target_repo are covered through _judge. The mixed case is covered only by test_guard_log_reports_a_mixed_route, the test_mixed_route_* tests with _mixed_ops(), and test_unsafe_pr_reissue_metadata_still_reports_mixed_harness_part.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: set heal_planned="true" when op = heal_report before the continue at line 646 (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:944-945 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Redundant or conflicting Telegram warnings when WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false.
  WHY: The telegram branch and the post-loop block can both warn for one verdict, causing paging noise.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:538 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The heal report is hardcoded to "issue" kind regardless of whether the item is an issue or a pull request.
  WHY: The intake rejects it as kind_mismatch, but the judge logs outcome=sent, which is a false success.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:646-649,939-956 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: In a mixed route, the heal report op is skipped when an earlier project-side op fails, and the failure notification is lost.
  WHY: The final warning is gated on heal_planned and heal_sent, so neither the report nor the warning is sent.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:913-921 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Telegram warnings are misattributed when a prior op failed and the heal report was skipped.
  WHY: The accurate planner WARNING is replaced by an inaccurate "a write failed" message.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:527-531 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The escalation label case list is a hardcoded copy of the contract and is not synchronized.
  WHY: If the label set expands, the judge rejects valid reports with label_not_accepted.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:646-650,860-871,942-953 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: On a mixed route heal_report is the last op (scripts/unblock_actions.py:1134-1136). When an earlier project-side op fails, the guard at line 646 skips it, so heal_planned stays false. A mixed route with an accepted label plans no telegram op either (scripts/unblock_actions.py:697-701).
  WHY: The harness part of the verdict is silently dropped and no page is sent.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:570,537 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The payload is always built as --kind issue, but for a PR item item.json carries a pull_request key. The intake rejects with kind_mismatch (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2609-2611).
  WHY: The intake drops the report, but the judge logs op=heal_report outcome=sent (line 605), so the log claims success for a report that was never filed.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:528-531 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The shell keeps its own copy of the accepted labels. The two Python copies are pinned equal by a test (tests/test_unblock_judge.py:4352-4355) but the shell copy is not pinned.
  WHY: If HUMAN_NEEDED_LABELS gains a label, the shell refuses it with label_not_accepted and the harness report is never sent.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:516-521,942-953 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false check runs before the label check, so the skip reason becomes workflow_heal_disabled. The planner WARNING and the post-loop WARNING both fire.
  WHY: The operator is paged twice for one blocked item.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:913-921 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The heal_report branch fires even when the op was skipped by the line 646 guard, and it sets heal_warned=true.
  WHY: The planner's accurate no-escalation-label WARNING is replaced by a "write failed" message that points at the wrong cause.
- TASK_GAP: tests/test_unblock_judge.py
  Requirement: "Done when: The judge tests cover the harness verdict, the mixed verdict and a missing field across P3a-P3b."
  Expected change site: tests/test_unblock_judge.py, a judge-path mixed-verdict test using the _judge helper
  Evidence of absence: The harness verdict (line 4617) and the missing target_repo (line 4628) go through the judge. The mixed-route tests (lines 4686, 4693, 4699) use hand-built op lists and test_guard_log_reports_a_mixed_route (line 4647) calls the helper directly.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 591, the dispatch envelope embeds the OIDC token and is written with the default umask. The suggested fix is umask 077 or a 0600 mktemp file (about 2 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh:528-531, add a parity test for the shell label list (about 8 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:646-649,861-869,944-951; scripts/unblock_actions.py:695-701,1134-1136 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A failure in an earlier fix-up op skips the mixed-route heal report before heal_planned is set. A sendable mixed verdict plans no Telegram warning, so the final warning path is skipped too.
  WHY: The harness report is lost and no warning is sent, although the verdict is already recorded.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:924-935,944-951 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The post-loop fallback sends a second WARNING when WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false and the item has no accepted label.
  WHY: The planner's WARNING at line 935 is sent, but the skip reason is workflow_heal_disabled, so heal_warned stays false and another WARNING fires.
- TASK_GAP: tests/test_unblock_judge.py
  Requirement: "Done when the judge tests cover the harness verdict, the mixed verdict and a missing field across P3a-P3b."
  Expected change site: tests/test_unblock_judge.py, a mixed verdict exercised through the judge path
  Evidence of absence: The judge-level tests cover a harness verdi
